AuditRecord.description: v7: the human or AI audit of the intended statements that the readout honoured.
AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord

Candidate.description:
v6: a screen statement retested on the confirmation's fresh questions. The Statement fields hold the
confirmation's numbers (verified_on, per_query_idx, verdicts and examples index confirmation.queries and
confirmation.responses); the screen_* fields copy the screen's, for comparison.
Candidate.title: Candidate

Check.description:
v7: one intended statement, read two ways (docs/discovery.md, "Two questions").

``does`` answers "does the model do what the part says?": an estimate from the with-part answers alone, read from
the rate and its by-question interval. ``cause`` answers "is the part the reason?": only the confirmation run can
say "confirmed".
Check.title: Check

ConfirmReading.description: v6: the per-part reading after confirmation.
ConfirmReading.title: ConfirmReading

ConfirmRule.description:
v6: how the candidates were chosen from the screen and when one counts as confirmed. Fixed in code
(spet/confirm.py) before any confirmation answer exists, and stored so the choice can be checked.
ConfirmRule.title: ConfirmRule

Confirmation.description: v6: confirmation of screen candidates on fresh questions (docs/discovery.md, "Confirmation").
Confirmation.title: Confirmation

ExcludedCheck.description: v7: an intended statement left out of the reading, and why.
ExcludedCheck.title: ExcludedCheck

PairExample.description: One paired cell where the judge said yes on one side and no on the other.
PairExample.title: PairExample

PartReading.description: What the verified statements say about one part, derived mechanically from them.
PartReading.title: PartReading

PartReadout.description: v7: one part's reading from its usable checks. Only "followed" carries a causal claim.
PartReadout.title: PartReadout

Readout.description: v7: two facts per intended statement and one reading per part (spet/readout.py; no model calls).
Readout.title: Readout

ReadoutRule.description: v7: the thresholds and exclusions the readout used (fixed in spet/readout.py).
ReadoutRule.title: ReadoutRule

ScreenPick.description: One pair the attention screen put in front of the proposer.
ScreenPick.title: ScreenPick

ScreenUse.description: v5: discovery ordered the proposer's pairs by an attention screen (scripts: deploy/modal_attention.py).
ScreenUse.title: ScreenUse

Statement.description: A yes/no-checkable claim about a single answer, judged on every answer of one part's pair of configs.
Statement.title: Statement
